bio: Hey 👋 I'm Hari — officially Srihari. Software engineer with 5+ years of experience who also paints 🎨, games 🎮, cooks 🍳, treks 🥾, overthinks 🤔, and reads everything including the back of shampoo bottles 📚.
If you're into sci-fi, fantasy, or anime 📺 — we're probably going to get along. I have strong opinions about both code and fictional worlds.
Also really into board games 🎲 — Catan, Carcassonne, anything with too many rules. Trying to find people to play with in Bangalore, so if you're a board game person, please text me. Genuinely.

I built [Ari](https://ariapp.co) — an AI assistant for Shopify stores 🛍️. It could handle queries, track orders, suggest products, and do virtual try-ons. Had to wind it down — running a startup alongside a full-time job is a lot, and the competition moved fast. Still learned a ton 💡.

Now I'm building [Iris](https://github.com/npx-idk/iris) — AI-powered testing 🤖 where you describe what should happen in plain English and it runs in a real browser. No brittle scripts, no setup nightmares.
